title: A nonnegative continuous compactly supported function that is positive at a unit vector u has positive H¹-integral over the line ℝu (parent step 4a)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let u ∈ ℝ^P with ‖u‖ = 1, and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support, f(y) ≥ 0 for all y, and f(u) > 0. Then ∫_{span{u}} f dH¹ > 0, where H¹ = μHE[1] is the normalized 1-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P and the integral is taken over the line span{u} = ℝu (with respect to H¹ restricted to that set).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u : Euclid P) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) → 0 < f u → 0 < ∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ {u} : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂(μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P))
